name: hirelayer
description: Resume and CV parsing, job criteria extraction, resume scoring and ranking, talent pool search, job recommendations and skills normalization for recruiters, hiring managers and HR tech teams.

interface.longDescription:
Screen candidates faster with HireLayer's recruiting tools: resume parsing, resume scoring and ranking, and search across the candidates and jobs you already have.

- Resume Parser: PDF, Word, images and scanned documents become structured candidate data (contact details, work experience, education, languages, skills and the full text). Attach a resume in the conversation or share a public link.
- Job Criteria Extractor: a job description becomes typed, weighted hiring criteria, each marked required, preferred or bonus.
- Resume Scorer: score up to 50 resumes against a job in one step, best first, each with a score from 0 to 1, a verdict, a summary and the evidence for every criterion. A precise ranking re-ranks the top 10 with a reason each.
- Talent Pool Search: find the candidates already in your HireLayer database closest to a job, around a city if you like.
- Job Recommendations: find your open jobs closest to a candidate.
- Skills Normalizer: map free-text skills in English or French to a skills taxonomy with stable IDs, useful for ATS and HR data.

Built for recruiters, hiring managers, talent acquisition teams, recruitment agencies and HR tech developers. Ask in plain language, for example "Screen these three resumes against our Senior React job and tell me who to interview" or "Which required criteria does this candidate miss?", and ChatGPT chains the tools and explains the result. Agencies can keep each client company's jobs and candidates in its own workspace.

Connect with your HireLayer account. HireLayer keeps the resumes, jobs and scores you process in your HireLayer account so you can score and search them again later; the tools never delete anything or change your other systems. Criteria and explanations are written in the job's language (English, French, German, Spanish or Portuguese). Scores support human hiring decisions; they never replace them. You can disconnect at any time from your HireLayer dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the attached resume for a recruiter.
Score this candidate against my job description and list the gaps.
Rank these resumes for my open role and explain the top pick.

positive.prompt: Summarize this candidate for a recruiter.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls parse_resume with the attached file and summarizes Alex Morgan: Senior Front-End Engineer in Lyon, 8 years of React and TypeScript, team lead, French and English.

positive.description: Parse a resume from a public URL
positive.prompt: Parse the resume at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HireLayer/hirelayer-mcp/main/examples/resume-sam-lee.txt and list the candidate's skills.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls parse_resume with file_url and lists Sam Lee's skills (Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, React, Vue.js, JavaScript, Docker).

positive.description: Extract weighted criteria from a job description
positive.prompt: Extract the hiring criteria from this job description and tell me which ones are must-haves: Senior React Developer: 5+ years of front-end development including 3+ years with React, strong TypeScript, automated testing (Jest, React Testing Library or Playwright), fluent English; nice to have: Next.js, GraphQL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract_job_criteria and returns typed, weighted criteria: 5+ years of front-end experience with 3+ years of React, TypeScript, automated testing and fluent English are required; Next.js and GraphQL are preferred or bonus.

positive.description: Rank three candidates for one job
positive.prompt: Rank these three candidates for the Senior React job and explain the order. Resumes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HireLayer/hirelayer-mcp/main/examples/resume-alex-morgan.txt, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HireLayer/hirelayer-mcp/main/examples/resume-camille-durand.txt, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HireLayer/hirelayer-mcp/main/examples/resume-sam-lee.txt. Job: Senior React Developer: 5+ years of front-end development including 3+ years with React, strong TypeScript, automated testing (Jest, React Testing Library or Playwright), fluent English; nice to have: Next.js, GraphQL.
positive.expected_behavior: Parses the three resumes from their URLs, scores them in one score_resumes call against the job description, and ranks Alex Morgan first (strong React and TypeScript fit), Camille Durand second (Vue.js rather than React) and Sam Lee third (mostly back end), each with a reason.

positive.prompt: Normalize these skills: Pack Office (Word, Excel), React.js, anglais courant.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls normalize_skills and returns three taxonomy skills with their IDs: Microsoft Office (from "Pack Office (Word, Excel)"), React and English, with nothing left unresolved.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Delete the candidate Alex Morgan from my ATS.

review.commerce_description: HireLayer does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resume parsing (including files attached in ChatGPT), job criteria extraction, resume scoring and ranking of up to 50 resumes with the evidence for every criterion, talent pool search, job recommendations and skills normalization. Criteria and explanations come in the job's language, and agencies can keep each client in its own workspace.

fr-FR.subtitle: Analyse de CV et classement
fr-FR.description: Triez vos candidats plus vite avec les outils de recrutement HireLayer : analyse de CV (PDF, Word, images, scans), extraction des critères d'une offre d'emploi, score de jusqu'à 50 CV par offre avec les preuves critère par critère et un classement précis des 10 meilleurs, recherche dans votre CVthèque, offres recommandées pour un candidat et normalisation des compétences. Pour les recruteurs, managers, cabinets et équipes RH. HireLayer conserve les CV, offres et scores dans votre compte pour les retrouver ensuite ; les scores aident la décision humaine sans la remplacer.
